description: READ work without taking it. With `id`, that piece of work: its markdown, read only; work over 20,000 characters comes back as an outline unless you ask for `section` or `full`. With `query`, the work whose words match. With neither, the board: what needs the person, who is on what, what is ready, and what this worktree holds. To DO the work, call take instead: it is the only way anyone learns somebody picked it up.

full.description: with id: the whole text, however long

id.description: passalong id (e.g. k3mq2xa7) or share link

query.description: words to look for in titles, tags and text

scope.description: with query: "mine", "all" (default), or a team slug

section.description: with id: only the part under this heading; see the outline

name: find_work
title: Find work
